b.include(subscriber(settlements, Place).build()) .out_retry(Publish::default()) .to("settlements.retry"); }) }

StartOffset says where a group starts on a partition with no committed offset: committed reset, earliest or latest. A group resumes from its committed offset whenever it has a valid one. StartOffset applies only where it has none: before the group's first commit on a partition, and after retention deleted the record a committed offset pointed at. The setting is librdkafka's auto.offset.reset, written on the descriptor with start. StartOffset::Committed, the default, leaves the choice to librdkafka, which resets to the end of the log. StartOffset::Earliest starts at the oldest record the topic retains. StartOffset::Latest starts at the end of the log: only records published after the subscription opened arrive. The second case matters for a group that sat idle longer than the topic's retention: with the default it skips to the end instead of reading what is left. A position that applies on every startup, whatever the group committed, is start_at.

A new archive group reads the invoices the topic held before the group existed. Macros Manual examples/kafka_subscriptions_start_offset.rs /// Archives every invoice: a new archive group starts at the oldest record the topic retains. #[subscriber(KafkaTopic::new("ledger.invoices").start(StartOffset::Earliest))] async fn archive(invoice: &Invoice) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(invoice.id, "archived"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } examples/manual/kafka_subscriptions_start_offset.rs /// Archives every invoice it reads. struct Archive; impl Handle<Invoice> for Archive { fn handle( &self, invoice: &Invoice, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(invoice.id, "archived"); ready(Ok(())) } } fn app(servers: &str, group: &str) -> impl App { let broker = KafkaBroker::new([servers]).default_group(group); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("archive", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { // A new archive group starts at the oldest record the topic retains. let invoices = KafkaTopic::new("ledger.invoices").start(StartOffset::Earliest); b.include( subscriber("ledger.invoices", Archive) .build() .map_source(|_| invoices), ); }) }

TestApp::start connects KafkaBroker to an in-process cluster with topics, groups, offsets and transactions. A test hands the harness the app main runs, unchanged, and addresses the broker by its production type, tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>(). The testing feature in [dev-dependencies] adds the in-process mode, and turns on the core's harness with it. The cluster has no settings of its own. It reads what librdkafka would read: the broker's config and producer_config, each descriptor's options, and librdkafka's defaults for the rest. A property name or value librdkafka refuses fails TestApp::start as it fails the connect. The cluster keeps Kafka's semantics. A topic comes into being with one partition when a record is produced to it or a subscription names it. Each consumer group reads a record once, and every group reads its own copy. The subscription's commit mode decides what is committed, and a seek moves the partitions the subscription reads. A read_committed reader, librdkafka's default, sees a transaction's records when it commits and never after an abort. The cluster refuses what a cluster refuses: a partition the topic lacks, an illegal topic name, a record over message.max.bytes. A publish through the harness returns once every handler it woke has settled, a reply or a committed transaction included. The assertions that follow read finished state. What only a cluster has, such as a topic with several partitions or the timing of a real group join, is for a live test.

The dependency line: [dev-dependencies] ruststream-rdkafka = { version = "0.7", features = ["testing"] } The first test publishes a payment and reads how the handler settled it. Macros Manual examples/kafka_testing.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_payment_is_accepted() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .message(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .subscriber("payments") .assert_called_once() .with(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); Ok(()) } examples/manual/kafka_testing.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_payment_is_accepted() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .message(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .subscriber("payments") .assert_called_once() .with(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); Ok(()) } A refund publishes its lines inside one transaction, and the handler commits or aborts it. The topic shows the lines of the committed refund and none of the aborted one. Macros Manual examples/kafka_testing.rs #[tokio::test] async fn an_aborted_refund_publishes_no_line() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; let refund = Refund { order_id: 1, lines: 3, settle: false, }; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .message(&refund) .publish() .await?; // A `read_committed` reader, librdkafka's default, never sees an aborted transaction. tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .published::<RefundLine>("refund-lines") .assert_not_called(); Ok(()) } #[tokio::test] async fn a_committed_refund_publishes_every_line() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; let refund = Refund { order_id: 2, lines: 3, settle: true, }; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .message(&refund) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .published::<RefundLine>("refund-lines") .assert_called(3); Ok(()) } examples/manual/kafka_testing.rs #[tokio::test] async fn an_aborted_refund_publishes_no_line() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; let refund = Refund { order_id: 1, lines: 3, settle: false, }; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .message(&refund) .publish() .await?; // A `read_committed` reader, librdkafka's default, never sees an aborted transaction. tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .published::<RefundLine>("refund-lines") .assert_not_called(); Ok(()) } #[tokio::test] async fn a_committed_refund_publishes_every_line() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; let refund = Refund { order_id: 2, lines: 3, settle: true, }; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .message(&refund) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .published::<RefundLine>("refund-lines") .assert_called(3); Ok(()) }

TestApp::start_live runs the same test body against a running Kafka, for what only a cluster has. It connects the broker through its ordinary connect, so startup probes the cluster and every group joins it for real. The body is the one an in-process test runs; only the start call differs. A publish, settle and advance wait on the real clock until every subscription has handled what was published to it. The wait lasts ten seconds at most, and start_live_within sets another bound. A consumer group takes a few seconds to form on a cluster, so a Kafka test gives it thirty. The live mode is for what the in-process cluster leaves out: a topic created with several partitions, the cooperative assignment that keeps partitions sticky, retention, and the timing of a group join. A cluster keeps what earlier runs left in it. Each run reads in a consumer group of its own, and creates its topics before the app starts: a group assigned a topic created after it subscribed reads from the end of the log, past the record that created the topic. In the example, live::url returns the cluster's address from KAFKA_TEST_URL, and the test returns early without one, so cargo test passes on a machine with no cluster. A job that stood a cluster up sets RUSTSTREAM_REQUIRE_LIVE=1, and a missing address then fails the test instead of skipping it. The repository's stand is docker-compose.test.yml, which just brokers-up starts.

The two tests share one body: one in process, one against the cluster at KAFKA_TEST_URL. Macros Manual examples/kafka_testing_live.rs /// The body both modes run; only the start call differs. async fn accepts_a_payment(tb: TestApp<()>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .message(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .subscriber("testing-live-payments") .assert_called_once() .with(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } #[tokio::test] async fn in_process() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { accepts_a_payment(TestApp::start(app("kafka:9092", "payments-svc")).await?).await } #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)] async fn against_the_stand() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let Some(servers) = live::url("KAFKA_TEST_URL") else { return Ok(()); }; ensure_topic(&servers, "testing-live-payments").await?; // A group of this run's own, so nothing an earlier run committed is read. let group = format!("payments-{}", process::id()); // A group forms on a cluster in seconds, more than the default ten-second bound allows for. let tb = TestApp::start_live_within(app(&servers, &group), Duration::from_secs(30)).await?; accepts_a_payment(tb).await } examples/manual/kafka_testing_live.rs /// The body both modes run; only the start call differs. async fn accepts_a_payment(tb: TestApp<()>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .message(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<KafkaBroker>() .subscriber("testing-live-payments") .assert_called_once() .with(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } #[tokio::test] async fn in_process() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { accepts_a_payment(TestApp::start(app("kafka:9092", "payments-svc")).await?).await } #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)] async fn against_the_stand() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let Some(servers) = live::url("KAFKA_TEST_URL") else { return Ok(()); }; ensure_topic(&servers, "testing-live-payments").await?; // A group of this run's own, so nothing an earlier run committed is read. let group = format!("payments-{}", process::id()); // A group forms on a cluster in seconds, more than the default ten-second bound allows for. let tb = TestApp::start_live_within(app(&servers, &group), Duration::from_secs(30)).await?; accepts_a_payment(tb).await }

transactional_id makes the publish policy transactional: publishes between begin and commit become visible together, or not at all. The policy it returns is KafkaTransactionalPublish, named TransactionalPublish in the prelude. It pairs into a KafkaTransactionalPublisher, which carries the core's TransactionalPublisher capability. A handler bounds its slot Out<impl TransactionalPublisher, Marker> and calls begin_transaction, then commit or abort. The producer is created and its transactions initialized at startup, when the policy pairs, so the handler holds a fenced producer from its first delivery. Readers at Kafka's default read_committed isolation see the records of a transaction at its commit; an abort discards them on the broker. Outside an open transaction the publisher sends like a plain one. The transactional id is the fencing unit: initializing a producer with an id fences the previous producer that held it. So the id is stable and unique per running instance, for example one per replica. transaction_timeout bounds how long begin, commit and abort may block (30 seconds by default). It is the call deadline; Kafka's own transaction.timeout.ms is a producer property, set through producer_config. queue_timeout bounds the wait for space in librdkafka's local queue. One producer runs one transaction at a time. A second begin_transaction while one is open returns KafkaError::TransactionBusy, and a commit or abort with nothing open returns KafkaError::NoTransaction. So the handlers of a workers(n) pool do not share one transactional publisher; per_partition gives each source partition a publisher of its own. The test harness records what the handler sent through the slot, committed or not, while the topic shows only what was committed.

An order ships one record per item, in one transaction. An item without a name aborts the transaction, which discards the shipments already sent. Macros Manual examples/kafka_transactions.rs #[derive(OutSlot)] #[publishes(Shipment)] struct Shipments; /// One shipment per item, published in one transaction. #[subscriber("orders")] async fn ship( order: &Order, Out(shipments): Out<impl TransactionalPublisher, Shipments>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { if shipments.begin_transaction().await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } for item in &order.items { if item.is_empty() { // The shipments already sent belong to the transaction, so the abort discards them. if shipments.abort().await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } tracing::warn!( order = order.id, "an item has no name, the order ships nothing" ); return HandlerOutcome::drop(); } let shipment = Shipment { order_id: order.id, item: item.clone(), }; if shipments.message(&shipment).publish().await.is_err() { shipments.abort().await.ok(); return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } } if shipments.commit().await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } HandlerOutcome::ack() } examples/manual/kafka_transactions.rs struct Shipments; impl OutSlot for Shipments { const NAME: &'static str = "Shipments"; type Destination = Reads; } impl PublishedThrough<Shipments> for Shipment {} /// One shipment per item, published in one transaction. struct Ship; impl<S> Handle<Order, (), Outs<(S,)>> for Ship where S: OutEntry<Shipments, Wire: TransactionalPublisher>, { async fn handle( &self, order: &Order, outs: &Outs<(S,)>, _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let shipments = outs.get(Shipments); if shipments.begin_transaction().await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } for item in &order.items { if item.is_empty() { // The shipments already sent belong to the transaction, so the abort discards // them. if shipments.abort().await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } tracing::warn!( order = order.id, "an item has no name, the order ships nothing" ); return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); } let shipment = Shipment { order_id: order.id, item: item.clone(), }; if shipments.message(&shipment).publish().await.is_err() { shipments.abort().await.ok(); return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } } if shipments.commit().await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } Ok(()) } } Macros Manual examples/kafka_transactions.rs fn app() -> impl App { let shipments = Publish::default() .transactional_id("shipments-svc-1") .transaction_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10)); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("shipments", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("shipments-svc"), |b| { b.include(ship).out(Shipments, shipments).build(); }, ) } examples/manual/kafka_transactions.rs fn app() -> impl App { let shipments = Publish::default() .transactional_id("shipments-svc-1") .transaction_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10)); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("shipments", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("shipments-svc"), |b| { b.include(subscriber("orders", Ship).build()) .out(Shipments, shipments) .build(); }, ) }

KafkaEosPublish commits consumed offsets inside the producer's transaction, so positions move atomically with the records published. It is the consume-transform-produce shape of Kafka (KIP-447), named EosPublish in the prelude. KafkaEosPublish::new takes the pipeline id, which is also the producer's transactional id. Each source subscription names the same id in Commit::Transactional: its consumer stops committing on its own, and the pipeline commits its offsets. One pipeline serves every lane of a workers(n, by_key) pool: publishes join the open transaction concurrently, and only the commit is exclusive. The pipeline works in windows. Every commit_interval (100 ms by default) it waits until the window's deliveries have settled, adds their positions and the group's metadata to the transaction, and commits. A record becomes visible at that commit, so end-to-end latency is at least the interval. A failed publish, a failed commit or a participant that does not settle in time aborts the window. The consumers then seek back to the last committed offsets, and the whole window is delivered and published again in a fresh transaction, so the output topic never holds a duplicate. A retry() from a participant holds its window until the transaction deadline, transaction_timeout. The retry_after copy does not apply to the pipeline's replies: a delayed copy would separate the record from its offset. The window's commit runs on the runtime the broker connected on, so a handler on a dedicated thread may open a window. The transactional commit needs consumer group membership. So Commit::Transactional is a KafkaTopic or KafkaTopics mode; KafkaPartitions, which joins no group, works with Commit::Auto and Commit::Tracked. A replying handler reaches the window through EosReplies, and a handler that publishes by hand through EosPipeline.

An order is priced, and the priced order commits together with the offset of the order it answers. Macros Manual examples/kafka_eos.rs /// Prices an order; the subscription commits its offsets through the `pricing-1` pipeline. #[subscriber( KafkaTopic::new("raw-orders").commit(Commit::Transactional("pricing-1".into())), reply )] async fn price(order: &Order) -> PricedOrder { PricedOrder { id: order.id, cents: order.cents, tax_cents: order.cents / 5, } } examples/manual/kafka_eos.rs /// Prices an order; the subscription commits its offsets through the `pricing-1` pipeline. struct Price; impl Handle<Order, PricedOrder> for Price { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<PricedOrder, HandlerOutcome>> { ready(Ok(PricedOrder { id: order.id, cents: order.cents, tax_cents: order.cents / 5, })) } } Macros Manual examples/kafka_eos.rs fn app() -> impl App { // The policy's id is the pipeline the subscription names, and the producer's transactional id. let pipeline = EosPublish::new("pricing-1").commit_interval(Duration::from_millis(100)); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("pricing", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("pricing-svc"), |b| { b.include(price).out_reply(pipeline).transform(EosReplies); }, ) } examples/manual/kafka_eos.rs fn app() -> impl App { // The policy's id is the pipeline the subscription names, and the producer's transactional id. let pipeline = EosPublish::new("pricing-1").commit_interval(Duration::from_millis(100)); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("pricing", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("pricing-svc"), |b| { let orders = subscriber("raw-orders", Price) .map_source(|_| { KafkaTopic::new("raw-orders").commit(Commit::Transactional("pricing-1".into())) }) .reply(); b.include(orders.build()) .out_reply(pipeline) .transform(EosReplies); }, ) }

EosPipeline::publish sends a record into the open window by hand, with the source coordinates the Source key gives. EosPipeline is the live form of EosPublish, so a slot bound to that policy holds one. A handler reaches it through the slot's Borrow<EosPipeline> bound, Out<impl Borrow<EosPipeline>>, and the manual form names it as the slot's wired value. The delivery's coordinates are a SourceOffset, read with Ctx<Source> (context::keys::Source). publish(&source, record, options) adds the record to the window and pairs it with that offset; None keeps the producer's own partition choice. A handler publishes as many records as it needs, then acks: the settled delivery is what lets the window commit. A failed publish poisons the window, which aborts and is delivered again, so the handler answers it with retry(). The record is an OutgoingMessage the handler encodes itself. id returns the pipeline id.

A cart is split into one record per item, and every record commits with the cart's offset. Macros Manual examples/kafka_eos_pipeline.rs /// Splits a cart into one record per item, all committed with the cart's offset. #[subscriber(KafkaTopic::new("carts").commit(Commit::Transactional("checkout-1".into())))] async fn split( cart: &Cart, Ctx(source): Ctx<Source>, Out(window): Out<impl Borrow<EosPipeline>>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { // The slot holds the paired pipeline, and `Borrow` is the bound that reaches it. let pipeline: &EosPipeline = (**window).borrow(); for item in &cart.items { let line = CartLine { cart_id: cart.id, item: item.clone(), }; let Ok(payload) = serde_json::to_vec(&line) else { return HandlerOutcome::drop(); }; let record = OutgoingMessage::new("cart-lines", payload.as_slice()); // A failed publish aborts the window, which redelivers the cart. if pipeline.publish(&source, record, None).await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } } HandlerOutcome::ack() } examples/manual/kafka_eos_pipeline.rs /// Splits a cart into one record per item, all committed with the cart's offset. struct Split; impl<W> Handle<Cart, (), Outs<(W,)>, KafkaContext> for Split where W: OutEntry<DefaultSlot, Wire = EosPipeline>, { async fn handle( &self, cart: &Cart, outs: &Outs<(W,)>, ctx: &mut Context<'_, KafkaContext>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let pipeline: &EosPipeline = outs.get(DefaultSlot); let source = ctx.context(Source); for item in &cart.items { let line = CartLine { cart_id: cart.id, item: item.clone(), }; let Ok(payload) = serde_json::to_vec(&line) else { return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); }; let record = OutgoingMessage::new("cart-lines", payload.as_slice()); // A failed publish aborts the window, which redelivers the cart. if pipeline.publish(&source, record, None).await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } } Ok(()) } } Macros Manual examples/kafka_eos_pipeline.rs fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("checkout", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("checkout-svc"), |b| { b.include(split) .out(DefaultSlot, EosPublish::new("checkout-1")) .build(); }, ) } examples/manual/kafka_eos_pipeline.rs fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("checkout", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("checkout-svc"), |b| { let carts = subscriber("carts", Split).map_source(|_| { KafkaTopic::new("carts").commit(Commit::Transactional("checkout-1".into())) }); b.include(carts.build()) .out(DefaultSlot, EosPublish::new("checkout-1")) .build(); }, ) }

EosReplies joins every reply to the pipeline's open window, paired with its delivery's consumed offset. It is a publish transform for the reply position, written after the policy: .out_reply(EosPublish::new(id)).transform(EosReplies). A Commit::Transactional subscription marks each delivery with its source coordinates, and the transform carries them onto the reply. The pipeline reads them, pairs the reply with that offset, and drops them before the record is produced, so they never reach the topic. The handler only returns its value: it names no publisher and no offset. Without the transform, a reply carries no coordinates and its publish fails with KafkaError::InvalidOptions, so nothing leaves outside the window. A reply from a subscription in another commit mode fails the same way. A handler that settles without a reply, a drop or an Err(outcome), publishes nothing, and its offset still commits with the window.

A payment is booked on a pool of four lanes; a payment of zero is dropped. Macros Manual examples/kafka_eos_replies.rs /// Books a payment; an empty one is dropped, and its offset still commits with the window. #[subscriber( KafkaTopic::new("payments").commit(Commit::Transactional("ledger-1".into())), reply, workers(4, by_key) )] async fn book(payment: &Payment) -> Result<LedgerEntry, HandlerOutcome> { if payment.cents == 0 { return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); } Ok(LedgerEntry { payment_id: payment.id, cents: payment.cents, }) } examples/manual/kafka_eos_replies.rs /// Books a payment; an empty one is dropped, and its offset still commits with the window. struct Book; impl Handle<Payment, LedgerEntry> for Book { fn handle( &self, payment: &Payment, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<LedgerEntry, HandlerOutcome>> { if payment.cents == 0 { return ready(Err(HandlerOutcome::drop())); } ready(Ok(LedgerEntry { payment_id: payment.id, cents: payment.cents, })) } } Macros Manual examples/kafka_eos_replies.rs fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("ledger", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("ledger-svc"), |b| { // The transform carries each delivery's coordinates onto its reply, where the pipeline // pairs them. b.include(book) .out_reply(EosPublish::new("ledger-1")) .transform(EosReplies); }, ) } examples/manual/kafka_eos_replies.rs fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("ledger", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("ledger-svc"), |b| { let payments = subscriber("payments", Book) .map_source(|_| { KafkaTopic::new("payments").commit(Commit::Transactional("ledger-1".into())) }) .reply() .workers_by_key(nonzero!(4)); // The transform carries each delivery's coordinates onto its reply, where the pipeline // pairs them. b.include(payments.build()) .out_reply(EosPublish::new("ledger-1")) .transform(EosReplies); }, ) }

per_partition gives each source partition its own transactional publisher, so a worker pool runs independent transactions. It turns the policy into a KafkaPartitionedPublish, named PartitionedPublish in the prelude. The transactional id becomes a base: the publisher of partition 3 is fenced by "{base}-p3". A handler bounds its slot Out<impl PartitionLanes> and reads its delivery's partition through Ctx<Partition>. PartitionLanes::for_partition returns that partition's publisher, created and initialized on first use. The live value is TransactionalPartitions, and its clones share the publishers. The scope is the source partition because one producer runs one transaction at a time. Under the default LaneKey::Partition, a workers(n, by_key) pool processes each partition in order on one lane, so each lane has a transaction of its own. The set of ids follows the topic's partitions, not the worker count: changing n keeps the ids and their fencing. It does not combine with LaneKey::RecordKey, which spreads one partition over several lanes; two lanes would then meet on one producer and get KafkaError::TransactionBusy. What a lane publishes leaves through the partition's own publisher, so a test reads it on the topic, not on the slot's record.

An invoice's lines are published in the transaction of the invoice's source partition. Macros Manual examples/kafka_transactions_partitions.rs /// Bills every line of an invoice in the transaction of the invoice's source partition. #[subscriber( KafkaTopic::new("invoice-batches").commit(Commit::Tracked), workers(4, by_key) )] async fn bill( invoice: &Invoice, Ctx(partition): Ctx<Partition>, Out(lanes): Out<impl PartitionLanes>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { let Ok(lane) = lanes.for_partition(partition).await else { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); }; if lane.begin_transaction().await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } for &amount in &invoice.amounts { let entry = InvoiceLine { invoice_id: invoice.id, amount, }; if lane.message(&entry).publish().await.is_err() { lane.abort().await.ok(); return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } } if lane.commit().await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } HandlerOutcome::ack() } examples/manual/kafka_transactions_partitions.rs /// Bills every line of an invoice in the transaction of the invoice's source partition. struct Bill; impl<L> Handle<Invoice, (), Outs<(L,)>, KafkaContext> for Bill where L: OutEntry<DefaultSlot, Wire: PartitionLanes>, { async fn handle( &self, invoice: &Invoice, outs: &Outs<(L,)>, ctx: &mut Context<'_, KafkaContext>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let partition = ctx.context(Partition); let Ok(lane) = outs.get(DefaultSlot).for_partition(partition).await else { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); }; if lane.begin_transaction().await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } for &amount in &invoice.amounts { let entry = InvoiceLine { invoice_id: invoice.id, amount, }; if lane.message(&entry).publish().await.is_err() { lane.abort().await.ok(); return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } } if lane.commit().await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } Ok(()) } } Macros Manual examples/kafka_transactions_partitions.rs fn app(servers: &str) -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("billing", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new([servers]).default_group("billing-svc"), |b| { // One transactional id per source partition: "billing-svc-1-p0", "billing-svc-1-p1". let lanes = Publish::default() .transactional_id("billing-svc-1") .per_partition(); b.include(bill).out(DefaultSlot, lanes).build(); }, ) } examples/manual/kafka_transactions_partitions.rs fn app(servers: &str) -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("billing", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new([servers]).default_group("billing-svc"), |b| { // One transactional id per source partition: "billing-svc-1-p0", "billing-svc-1-p1". let lanes = Publish::default() .transactional_id("billing-svc-1") .per_partition(); let invoices = subscriber("invoice-batches", Bill) .map_source(|_| KafkaTopic::new("invoice-batches").commit(Commit::Tracked)) .workers_by_key(nonzero!(4)); b.include(invoices.build()).out(DefaultSlot, lanes).build(); }, ) }

本指南选择 ack 和 nack 在 Kafka 上提交什么：librdkafka 自己的提交、Commit::Tracked 下精确的至少一次，以及逐个元素结算的批。 Kafka 不结算单条消息。 消费者组为每个分区提交一个位置，位置之前的一切都算作已读。 处理器仍然结算每次投递，所以由订阅的 Commit 模式决定这些结算如何变成位置。 模式 ack drop retry 崩溃之后 Auto（默认） 什么也不做 什么也不做 报告不支持，记录不会回来 已处理记录的尾部被重新读取，或者已存储但未处理的记录被跳过 Tracked 结算该偏移量 结算该偏移量 记录会回来 每条未结算的记录都被重新读取 Transactional 结算该偏移量，随流水线的事务一起提交 与 ack 相同 让窗口停住，直到事务的截止时间 打开的窗口被重新读取 示例是一个付款服务：付款不能丢，页面浏览可以丢。 事务与精确一次讲解第三种模式。

pay_out 通过银行发出一笔付款，并以确认作为回复。 银行没有应答时，付款会回来，再试一次。 宏 手写 src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct Payout { id: u64, amount_cents: u64, } #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "payouts.done")] struct Paid { payout_id: u64, } #[subscriber(KafkaTopic::new("payouts").commit(Commit::Tracked), reply)] async fn pay_out(payout: &Payout, State(bank): State<Arc<Bank>>) -> Result<Paid, HandlerOutcome> { if payout.amount_cents == 0 { return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); } if bank.0.call().await.is_err() { tracing::warn!(payout.id, "bank unavailable, payout comes back"); return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } tracing::info!(payout.id, payout.amount_cents, "payout sent"); Ok(Paid { payout_id: payout.id, }) } src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Payout { id: u64, amount_cents: u64, } #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Paid { payout_id: u64, } impl OutgoingDestination for Paid { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "payouts.done"; } impl MessageHeaders for Paid { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for Paid { const NAME: &'static str = "Paid"; } struct PayOut; impl Handle<Payout, Paid, (), (), Clients> for PayOut { async fn handle( &self, payout: &Payout, _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Clients>, ) -> Result<Paid, HandlerOutcome> { if payout.amount_cents == 0 { return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); } if ctx.state().bank.call().await.is_err() { tracing::warn!(payout.id, "bank unavailable, payout comes back"); return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } tracing::info!(payout.id, payout.amount_cents, "payout sent"); Ok(Paid { payout_id: payout.id, }) } } 在 Commit::Tracked 下，ack 把已提交的位置上移到仍未完成的最低投递处。 并发工作者发来的 ack 不按顺序到达，而位置绝不会越过仍在处理中的付款。 retry 把投递交还给它的订阅，订阅会在接下来拉取的任何内容之前再次投递它。 在此之前，它的偏移量一直未完成，所以位置不会越过它。 先停止的进程再次启动时，会从 Kafka 重新拿到这笔付款。 因此付款绝不会丢失，但可能被处理两次：崩溃前一次，崩溃后一次。 银行调用必须能接受重复的付款，比如按付款 id 去重。 没有尝试上限的 retry 会无休止地回来；重试与死信主题加上这个上限。

count_view 在分析存储中统计页面浏览。 这里丢一次浏览无关紧要，所以订阅保留默认模式。 宏 手写 src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct PageView { page: String, } #[subscriber(KafkaTopic::new("page-views").group("analytics"))] async fn count_view(view: &PageView, State(counters): State<Arc<Counters>>) -> HandlerOutcome { if counters.0.call().await.is_err() { // Under `Commit::Auto` nothing brings the view back; analytics accepts the loss. return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } tracing::debug!(page = %view.page, "page view counted"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct PageView { page: String, } struct CountView; impl Handle<PageView, (), (), (), Clients> for CountView { async fn handle( &self, view: &PageView, _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Clients>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { if ctx.state().counters.call().await.is_err() { // Under `Commit::Auto` nothing brings the view back; analytics accepts the loss. return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } tracing::debug!(page = %view.page, "page view counted"); Ok(()) } } 在 Commit::Auto 下，librdkafka 在把记录交给应用时存储位置，并按计时器提交。 ack 和 drop 不改变任何东西。 retry 报告自己不受支持，浏览记录不会回来。 这种模式开销最小，而崩溃可能丢失已处理的记录，或者跳过已存储但未处理的记录。

reconcile 以最多 500 行的批接收对账单行，并逐行单独结算。 宏 手写 src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct StatementLine { payout_id: u64, amount_cents: u64, } #[subscriber(KafkaTopic::new("statements").group("reconciliation").commit(Commit::Tracked))] async fn reconcile(lines: &[StatementLine]) -> Vec<HandlerOutcome> { lines .iter() .map(|line| { if line.amount_cents == 0 { tracing::warn!(line.payout_id, "empty statement line dropped"); return HandlerOutcome::drop(); } HandlerOutcome::ack() }) .collect() } src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct StatementLine { payout_id: u64, amount_cents: u64, } struct Reconcile; impl Handle<[StatementLine], (), (), (), Clients> for Reconcile { fn handle( &self, lines: &[StatementLine], _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Clients>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), Vec<HandlerOutcome>>> { if lines.iter().all(|line| line.amount_cents > 0) { return ready(Ok(())); } let outcomes = lines .iter() .map(|line| { if line.amount_cents == 0 { tracing::warn!(line.payout_id, "empty statement line dropped"); return HandlerOutcome::drop(); } HandlerOutcome::ack() }) .collect(); ready(Err(outcomes)) } } 一批是一次投递加上 librdkafka 已经拉取到的记录，不会额外等待，所以它往往小于挂载点指定的大小。 返回的列表逐个元素结算这一批；在手写形式中，Ok(()) 对每个元素 ack，Err(outcomes) 逐个结算。 在 Commit::Tracked 下，请求重试的元素单独回来，已提交的位置停在它前面，直到它结算。 先停止的进程会重新读取它后面已 ack 的元素：结果是重复，而不是丢失。 librdkafka 在队列中保留多少记录是消费者属性，用 KafkaTopic::config 设置。 队列满时，librdkafka 暂停拉取 fetch.queue.backoff.ms（默认 1000 毫秒），这会让慢处理器后面的大记录变慢。 .config("fetch.queue.backoff.ms", "10") 缩短这次暂停。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App<State = Clients> { let broker = KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]) .default_group("payouts") .producer_config("enable.idempotence", "true") .flush_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10)); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("payouts", "0.1.0")) .on_startup(async move |()| Ok::<_, Infallible>(Clients::default())) .with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include(pay_out) .out_reply(Publish::default().queue_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))); b.include(count_view); b.include(reconcile.batch(nonzero!(500usize))); }) } src/main.rs fn app() -> impl App<State = Clients> { let broker = KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]) .default_group("payouts") .producer_config("enable.idempotence", "true") .flush_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10)); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("payouts", "0.1.0")) .on_startup(async move |()| Ok::<_, Infallible>(Clients::default())) .with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include( subscriber("payouts", PayOut) .map_source(|_| KafkaTopic::new("payouts").commit(Commit::Tracked)) .reply() .build(), ) .out_reply(Publish::default().queue_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))); b.include( subscriber("page-views", CountView) .map_source(|_| KafkaTopic::new("page-views").group("analytics")) .build(), ); b.include( subscriber("statements", Reconcile) .batch(nonzero!(500usize)) .map_source(|_| { KafkaTopic::new("statements") .group("reconciliation") .commit(Commit::Tracked) }) .build(), ); }) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } 端到端的至少一次也需要生产者一侧配合。 enable.idempotence 让 librdkafka 自己重发的记录只落地一次；producer_config 设置它以及其他所有生产者属性，包括 acks。 每次发布都等待集群的投递报告，所以返回 Ok 的发布已被 Kafka 接受。 librdkafka 的本地队列已满时，发布会等待空间，这让处理器放慢到集群能承受的速度。 queue_timeout 限制这次等待，并把超时变成错误。 关闭时，Broker 会把仍在传输中的记录刷出去，最多等待 flush_timeout（默认 30 秒）。 ClosedKafkaBroker::unflushed_records 统计没能发出的记录。 示例文件中的测试在进程内运行应用，并用失败一次的客户端替换银行和分析存储。 进程内 Kafka 像集群一样提交，所以付款在 Commit::Tracked 下会回来，页面浏览在 Commit::Auto 下不会回来。
本指南把多条记录作为一个 Kafka 事务发布，在工作者池下运行事务，并让消费-转换-生产处理器做到精确一次。 Kafka 事务让一组记录同时变得可见。 read_committed 隔离级别（librdkafka 的默认值）下的读者，在事务提交后看到全部记录，在事务中止后一条也看不到。 在 RustStream 中，事务是挂载点上发布策略的属性，处理器只说明它用到的能力。

ship 把一个已付款的订单变成每件商品一行的发货单。 带有空订单行的订单会被丢弃，它的任何一行都不能到达仓库。 宏 手写 src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct Order { id: u64, items: Vec<Item>, } #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct Item { sku: String, quantity: u32, } /// One shipment line per item of a paid order. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "shipment-lines")] struct ShipmentLine { order_id: u64, sku: String, quantity: u32, } #[derive(OutSlot)] #[publishes(ShipmentLine)] struct Shipments; #[subscriber(KafkaTopic::new("paid-orders").group("shipping").commit(Commit::Tracked))] async fn ship( order: &Order, Out(shipments): Out<impl TransactionalPublisher, Shipments>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { if shipments.begin_transaction().await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } for item in &order.items { if item.quantity == 0 { tracing::warn!(order.id, sku = %item.sku, "order with an empty line dropped"); return match shipments.abort().await { Ok(()) => HandlerOutcome::drop(), Err(_) => HandlerOutcome::retry(), }; } let line = ShipmentLine { order_id: order.id, sku: item.sku.clone(), quantity: item.quantity, }; if shipments.message(&line).publish().await.is_err() { shipments.abort().await.ok(); return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } } if shipments.commit().await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } tracing::info!(order.id, lines = order.items.len(), "order shipped"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Order { id: u64, items: Vec<Item>, } #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Item { sku: String, quantity: u32, } /// One shipment line per item of a paid order. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct ShipmentLine { order_id: u64, sku: String, quantity: u32, } // `#[derive(Outgoing)]` with `#[outgoing(name = "shipment-lines")]`, by hand. impl OutgoingDestination for ShipmentLine { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "shipment-lines"; } impl MessageHeaders for ShipmentLine { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for ShipmentLine { const NAME: &'static str = "ShipmentLine"; const DESCRIPTION: Option<&'static str> = None; } /// The slot the shipment lines leave through. struct Shipments; impl OutSlot for Shipments { const NAME: &'static str = "Shipments"; // `ShipmentLine` fixes its destination, so no transform on this slot may name one. type Destination = Reads; } impl PublishedThrough<Shipments> for ShipmentLine {} struct Ship; impl<S> Handle<Order, (), Outs<(S,)>> for Ship where S: OutEntry<Shipments, Wire: TransactionalPublisher>, { async fn handle( &self, order: &Order, outs: &Outs<(S,)>, _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let shipments = outs.get(Shipments); if shipments.begin_transaction().await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } for item in &order.items { if item.quantity == 0 { tracing::warn!(order.id, sku = %item.sku, "order with an empty line dropped"); return match shipments.abort().await { Ok(()) => Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()), Err(_) => Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()), }; } let line = ShipmentLine { order_id: order.id, sku: item.sku.clone(), quantity: item.quantity, }; if shipments.message(&line).publish().await.is_err() { shipments.abort().await.ok(); return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } } if shipments.commit().await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } tracing::info!(order.id, lines = order.items.len(), "order shipped"); Ok(()) } } 处理器以 Out<impl TransactionalPublisher, Shipments> 接收它的槽位：它只说出核心的 TransactionalPublisher 能力，不涉及任何 Kafka 的东西。 在 begin_transaction 和 commit 之间发布的记录同时变得可见。 abort 丢弃这些记录，所以带空订单行的订单，其第一行永远不会到达读者。 在打开的事务之外，这个槽位像普通槽位一样发布。 已有事务打开时再次调用 begin_transaction 会报告 KafkaError::TransactionBusy，没有打开的事务时调用 commit 或 abort 会报告 KafkaError::NoTransaction。 事务覆盖发布的订单行，不覆盖消费的订单。 Commit::Tracked 在处理器 ack 订单之后提交它的偏移量。 如果在两者之间崩溃，订单会再次投递，它的订单行会被第二次发货。 下面的精确一次流水线消除了这个缺口。
documents.s: 在一个处理器中全有或全无

documents.t: 一个 Kafka 生产者一次只运行一个事务，所以工作者池中的处理器不能共用一个事务性发布者。 invoice 运行四个工作分区，并给每个来源分区一个独立的事务。 宏 手写 src/main.rs /// One invoice line per item of a billed order. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "invoice-items")] struct InvoiceItem { order_id: u64, sku: String, quantity: u32, } #[subscriber( KafkaTopic::new("billable-orders").group("invoicing").commit(Commit::Tracked), workers(4, by_key) )] async fn invoice( order: &Order, Ctx(partition): Ctx<Partition>, Out(lanes): Out<impl PartitionLanes>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { let Ok(items) = lanes.for_partition(partition).await else { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); }; if items.begin_transaction().await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } for item in &order.items { let line = InvoiceItem { order_id: order.id, sku: item.sku.clone(), quantity: item.quantity, }; if items.message(&line).publish().await.is_err() { items.abort().await.ok(); return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } } if items.commit().await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } tracing::info!(order.id, partition, "order invoiced"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs /// One invoice line per item of a billed order. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct InvoiceItem { order_id: u64, sku: String, quantity: u32, } impl OutgoingDestination for InvoiceItem { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "invoice-items"; } impl MessageHeaders for InvoiceItem { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for InvoiceItem { const NAME: &'static str = "InvoiceItem"; const DESCRIPTION: Option<&'static str> = None; } /// Declaring `KafkaContext` is what gives the body the delivery's partition. struct Invoice; impl<L> Handle<Order, (), Outs<(L,)>, KafkaContext> for Invoice where L: OutEntry<DefaultSlot, Wire: PartitionLanes>, { async fn handle( &self, order: &Order, outs: &Outs<(L,)>, ctx: &mut Context<'_, KafkaContext>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let partition = ctx.context(Partition); let Ok(items) = outs.get(DefaultSlot).for_partition(partition).await else { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); }; if items.begin_transaction().await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } for item in &order.items { let line = InvoiceItem { order_id: order.id, sku: item.sku.clone(), quantity: item.quantity, }; if items.message(&line).publish().await.is_err() { items.abort().await.ok(); return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } } if items.commit().await.is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } tracing::info!(order.id, partition, "order invoiced"); Ok(()) } } workers(4, by_key) 按分区划分工作分区，所以一个分区在一个工作分区上按顺序处理。 槽位是 PartitionLanes：for_partition 返回投递所在分区的事务性发布者，它在第一次使用时创建。 处理不同分区的工作分区同时运行各自的事务。 事务 id 跟随主题的分区，而不是工作者的数量，所以修改 workers(n) 不会改变任何 id。 这个方案需要默认的分区键。 LaneKey::RecordKey 会把一个分区分散到多个工作分区上，它们就会共用这个分区的发布者，并在它唯一的事务上冲突。

enrich 读取一个已下的订单，并以仓库用于规划的汇总作为回复。 每个回复都恰好发布一次，即使服务崩溃、订单被再读一遍也是如此。 宏 手写 src/main.rs /// A placed order with the totals the warehouse plans with. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "enriched-orders")] struct EnrichedOrder { id: u64, lines: usize, units: u32, } #[subscriber( KafkaTopic::new("placed-orders") .group("enrichment") .commit(Commit::Transactional("enrichment-1".into())), reply, workers(4, by_key) )] async fn enrich(order: &Order) -> EnrichedOrder { let units = order.items.iter().map(|item| item.quantity).sum(); tracing::info!(order.id, units, "order enriched"); EnrichedOrder { id: order.id, lines: order.items.len(), units, } } src/main.rs /// A placed order with the totals the warehouse plans with. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct EnrichedOrder { id: u64, lines: usize, units: u32, } impl OutgoingDestination for EnrichedOrder { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "enriched-orders"; } impl MessageHeaders for EnrichedOrder { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for EnrichedOrder { const NAME: &'static str = "EnrichedOrder"; const DESCRIPTION: Option<&'static str> = None; } struct Enrich; impl Handle<Order, EnrichedOrder> for Enrich { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<EnrichedOrder, HandlerOutcome>> { let units = order.items.iter().map(|item| item.quantity).sum(); tracing::info!(order.id, units, "order enriched"); ready(Ok(EnrichedOrder { id: order.id, lines: order.items.len(), units, })) } } 处理器只返回它的回复，不包含任何事务代码。 Commit::Transactional("enrichment-1") 让订阅不再自己提交偏移量。 改由同一 id 的流水线在承载回复的事务中提交它们。 于是已消费的位置和已发布的记录一起移动：要么都提交，要么都不提交。

挂载点指定每个槽位和回复背后的发布策略。 宏 手写 src/main.rs fn service(broker: KafkaBroker) -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("fulfilment", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { // One transactional id per service instance. b.include(ship) .out(Shipments, Publish::default().transactional_id("shipping-1")) .build(); // One transactional id per source partition: "invoicing-1-p0", "invoicing-1-p1", ... b.include(invoice) .out( DefaultSlot, Publish::default() .transactional_id("invoicing-1") .per_partition(), ) .build(); // The pipeline's id is the one the subscription's commit mode names. b.include(enrich) .out_reply(EosPublish::new("enrichment-1")) .transform(EosReplies); }) } #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App { service(KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"])) } src/main.rs fn service(broker: KafkaBroker) -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("fulfilment", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { // One transactional id per service instance. let paid = subscriber("paid-orders", Ship).map_source(|_| { KafkaTopic::new("paid-orders") .group("shipping") .commit(Commit::Tracked) }); b.include(paid.build()) .out(Shipments, Publish::default().transactional_id("shipping-1")) .build(); // One transactional id per source partition: "invoicing-1-p0", "invoicing-1-p1", ... let billable = subscriber("billable-orders", Invoice) .map_source(|_| { KafkaTopic::new("billable-orders") .group("invoicing") .commit(Commit::Tracked) }) .workers_by_key(nonzero!(4)); b.include(billable.build()) .out( DefaultSlot, Publish::default() .transactional_id("invoicing-1") .per_partition(), ) .build(); // The pipeline's id is the one the subscription's commit mode names. let placed = subscriber("placed-orders", Enrich) .map_source(|_| { KafkaTopic::new("placed-orders") .group("enrichment") .commit(Commit::Transactional("enrichment-1".into())) }) .reply() .workers_by_key(nonzero!(4)); b.include(placed.build()) .out_reply(EosPublish::new("enrichment-1")) .transform(EosReplies); }) } fn app() -> impl App { service(KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"])) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } transactional_id 把普通策略变成事务性策略。 一个事务 id 属于一个存活的生产者：以同一 id 启动的第二个生产者会隔离第一个，第一个从此无法提交。 给服务的每个运行实例一个独立的 id，比如取自 pod 的序号。 per_partition 让这个 id 成为基础名：invoice 的发布者使用 invoicing-1-p0、invoicing-1-p1 等 id。 EosPublish::new("enrichment-1") 就是流水线，它的 id 正是订阅的提交模式所指定的那个。 EosReplies 把每次投递的来源位置带到它的回复上，流水线靠它把两者配对。 没有它，第一个回复会失败，而不是在事务之外发出。

流水线把回复收集到一个窗口中，每隔 commit_interval 提交一次，未设置时为 100 毫秒。 在窗口结束时，它等待向这个窗口发布过的每次投递完成结算，把它们的位置和组的元数据加入事务，然后提交。 因此，回复最早也要在处理器返回它之后一个提交间隔才变得可见。 发布失败、提交失败，或者某次投递没有按时结算，都会中止这个窗口。 随后消费者 seek 回最后一次提交的偏移量，整个窗口在新的事务中再处理一遍。 已提交的输出中，每个回复仍然只出现一次。 流水线限制了它的处理器能返回什么、以及如何读取： 处理器返回的 retry() 会让它的窗口一直打开，直到事务超时（未用 transaction_timeout 另行设置时为 30 秒），然后窗口重放。 retry_after 不适用于流水线中的处理器：它延迟的副本在窗口之外发布，破坏了记录与偏移量的配对。 KafkaPartitions 不能与 Commit::Transactional 组合，这样的订阅无法启动：流水线通过消费者组提交，而读取固定分区的读者不参与任何组。
本指南安装 ruststream-rdkafka，启动一个本地 Kafka，并让第一个服务连上它运行。

Cargo.toml [dependencies] ruststream = { version = "0.7", features = ["macros", "json", "logging"] } ruststream-rdkafka = "0.7" serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] } tracing = "0.1" [dev-dependencies] ruststream-rdkafka = { version = "0.7", features = ["testing"] } tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros", "rt"] } ruststream 是框架本身：macros 提供属性宏，json 提供默认编解码器，logging 把服务的日志打印到终端。 ruststream-rdkafka 是 Kafka Broker。 它的 testing feature 加入测试所用的进程内 Kafka。 这个 Broker crate 有以下 feature： Feature 提供的内容 json （默认）、msgpack、cbor 同名的编解码器 schema-registry Confluent Schema Registry 客户端及其线上格式 avro 基于 Schema Registry 的 Avro protobuf 带 Confluent 信封的 Protobuf 消息 asyncapi 生成的 AsyncAPI 文档中的 Kafka 绑定 testing TestApp 背后的进程内 Kafka ssl 通过系统 OpenSSL 提供 TLS ssl-vendored 通过从源码构建的 OpenSSL 提供 TLS zstd zstd 压缩编解码器

本 crate 从源码构建 librdkafka，即 Kafka 的 C 客户端。 构建需要 C 编译器和 make；librdkafka 用自己的脚本完成配置。 在 Debian 和 Ubuntu 上，build-essential 同时提供这两者。 ssl feature 还需要 OpenSSL 头文件（libssl-dev），ssl-vendored 需要 perl 来构建 OpenSSL。 CMake 构建或系统自带的 librdkafka 是 rust-rdkafka 的 feature：把 rdkafka 连同所需的 feature 加入你自己的依赖，构建就会采用它。

开发时，一个 KRaft 模式的 Kafka 节点就够了： compose.yaml services: kafka: image: apache/kafka:4.0.0 ports: - "9092:9092" 启动它，并创建服务读取的主题： docker compose up -d docker compose exec kafka /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh \ --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --create --topic orders Broker 监听 localhost:9092。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct Order { id: u64, amount_cents: u64, } #[subscriber("orders")] async fn take_order(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { if order.amount_cents == 0 { tracing::warn!(order.id, "order without an amount dropped"); return HandlerOutcome::drop(); } tracing::info!(order.id, order.amount_cents, "order taken"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("orders-svc"), |b| { b.include(take_order); }, ) } src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Order { id: u64, amount_cents: u64, } struct TakeOrder; impl Handle<Order> for TakeOrder { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { if order.amount_cents == 0 { tracing::warn!(order.id, "order without an amount dropped"); return ready(Err(HandlerOutcome::drop())); } tracing::info!(order.id, order.amount_cents, "order taken"); ready(Ok(())) } } fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")).with_broker( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("orders-svc"), |b| { b.include(subscriber("orders", TakeOrder).build()); }, ) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } take_order 从 orders 主题读取 JSON 订单。 带金额的订单被 ack，没有金额的订单被丢弃。 KafkaBroker::new 接收引导服务器地址，只把它们记录下来。 连接在服务启动时才打开。 Kafka 只在消费者组内读取主题。 default_group 是所有没有指定组的订阅所用的组。 #[ruststream::app] 把 app 变成 main；在手写形式中，run_main 做同样的事。 运行服务： cargo run -- run 在另一个终端里，用镜像自带的控制台生产者发布一个订单： echo '{"id":1,"amount_cents":1250}' | docker compose exec -T kafka \ /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-console-producer.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --topic orders 服务记录一条带订单 id 的 order taken 日志。 Ctrl+C 停止服务。 cargo generate 可以生成同类服务的脚手架，其中带有路由器和回复： cargo generate --git https://github.com/powersemmi/ruststream-rdkafka templates/kafka-topic --name my-service
示例文件里还有两个测试。 每个测试都用 TestApp::start 启动同一个 app，发布一个订单，然后检查 take_order 如何结算它。 在测试中，KafkaBroker 连接的是进程内 Kafka，所以测试不需要集群： cargo test 测试 Kafka 服务逐一讲解这些测试，以及进程内 Kafka 模拟了什么。

基于 rust-rdkafka 的服务要自己编写消费者循环和生产者。 下表列出每一部分在 RustStream 中的位置： rust-rdkafka RustStream ClientConfig::new().set("group.id", ..) default_group，或按订阅设置的 KafkaTopic::group 用 ClientConfig::set 设置其他任何属性 KafkaBroker::config、producer_config、KafkaTopic::config StreamConsumer::subscribe 加一个 recv 循环 一个 #[subscriber] 处理器 反序列化 message.payload() 处理器的参数类型，由编解码器解码 处理完成后调用 store_offset 或 commit_message Commit::Tracked 加上处理器的结果（提交与投递保证） FutureProducer::send 回复或 Out 参数，经由发布策略发送 seek 和 assign 挂载点上的 start_at，或处理器中的 seek 句柄（重放与 seek） send_offsets_to_transaction EosPublish（事务与精确一次）
本指南在消费者组中读取主题，用并行的工作分区保持每个键的顺序，并按键、按编号或轮流把记录放到分区上。 示例是一家银行的账簿服务。 它把转账记入账户账簿，筛查欺诈，为自己的记录维护索引，并为有争议的转账立案。

Kafka 在一个分区内保持记录的顺序。 键相同的记录落到同一个分区，所以每个键的顺序得以保持。 post 读取以账户为键的转账，最多同时处理八条，而且不打乱这个顺序。 宏 手写 src/main.rs /// The account a record belongs to, carried as the Kafka record key. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)] struct AccountKey { #[serde(rename = "kafka-partition-key")] account: String, } #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct Transfer { id: u64, amount_cents: i64, } /// One line of an account's ledger, keyed by the account like the transfer it came from. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "bank.entries", headers = AccountKey)] struct Entry { transfer_id: u64, amount_cents: i64, } #[derive(OutSlot)] #[publishes(Entry)] struct Entries; #[subscriber( KafkaTopic::new("transfers").lane_key(LaneKey::RecordKey), workers(8, by_key) )] async fn post( transfer: &Transfer, Headers(key): Headers<AccountKey>, Out(entries): Out<impl Publisher, Entries>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { let entry = Entry { transfer_id: transfer.id, amount_cents: transfer.amount_cents, }; if entries .message(&entry) .with_headers(&key) .publish() .await .is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } tracing::info!(transfer.id, account = %key.account, "transfer posted"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs /// The account a record belongs to, carried as the Kafka record key. #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct AccountKey { #[serde(rename = "kafka-partition-key")] account: String, } #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Transfer { id: u64, amount_cents: i64, } /// One line of an account's ledger, keyed by the account like the transfer it came from. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Entry { transfer_id: u64, amount_cents: i64, } impl OutgoingDestination for Entry { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "bank.entries"; } impl MessageHeaders for Entry { type Contract = WithHeaders<AccountKey>; } impl MessageInfo for Entry { const NAME: &'static str = "Entry"; } struct Entries; impl OutSlot for Entries { const NAME: &'static str = "Entries"; type Destination = Reads; } impl PublishedThrough<Entries> for Entry {} struct Post; impl<Ledger> Handle<Message<AccountKey, Transfer>, (), Outs<(Ledger,)>> for Post where Ledger: OutEntry<Entries, Wire: Publisher>, { async fn handle( &self, transfer: &Message<AccountKey, Transfer>, outs: &Outs<(Ledger,)>, _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let key = &transfer.headers; let entry = Entry { transfer_id: transfer.body.id, amount_cents: transfer.body.amount_cents, }; if outs .get(Entries) .message(&entry) .with_headers(key) .publish() .await .is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } tracing::info!(transfer.body.id, account = %key.account, "transfer posted"); Ok(()) } } workers(8, by_key) 运行八个工作分区；分区键相同的投递在同一个工作分区上依次运行。 LaneKey::RecordKey 以记录键作为分区键，所以同一账户的两笔转账绝不会同时运行，即使它们在同一个分区内。 默认的 LaneKey::Partition 以来源分区作为分区键，这也覆盖了没有键的记录。 在手写形式中，同一设置是 workers_by_key。 记录键以 kafka-partition-key 消息头（PARTITION_KEY_HEADER）到达处理器。 AccountKey 是一个消息头契约，只有一个以该名字命名的字段。 Headers<AccountKey> 读取投递的键，with_headers(&key) 把它写成账簿条目的键。 于是条目在 bank.entries 中也落到其账户的分区上，账簿的读者按顺序看到每个账户。 没有键的转账不满足消息头契约，由解码策略结算，默认会丢弃它。

一个消费者组对每条记录只读取一次，不论该分区分配给了组里的哪个成员。 每个组都读取自己的一份。 screen 在自己的组中读取同样的转账，所以 post 看到的每笔转账它都能看到。 宏 手写 src/main.rs #[subscriber( KafkaTopic::new("transfers") .group("fraud-check") .start(StartOffset::Earliest) .assignment(Assignment::CooperativeSticky) )] async fn screen(transfer: &Transfer) -> HandlerOutcome { if transfer.amount_cents > 1_000_000 { tracing::warn!(transfer.id, "large transfer flagged"); } HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs struct Screen; impl Handle<Transfer> for Screen { fn handle( &self, transfer: &Transfer, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { if transfer.amount_cents > 1_000_000 { tracing::warn!(transfer.id, "large transfer flagged"); } ready(Ok(())) } } KafkaTopic::group 指定组。 没有指定组的订阅加入 Broker 的 default_group；post 就是这样。 Kafka 只在组内读取主题，所以两者都没有的服务会在启动时失败。 StartOffset 决定组在某个分区上没有已提交的偏移量时从哪里开始。 组第一次运行时，以及保留策略删除了它的偏移量之后，都属于这种情况。 Earliest 从最旧的记录开始，Latest 从日志末尾开始，默认的 Committed 把选择交给 librdkafka 的 auto.offset.reset，其值为 latest。 Assignment 选择组在成员之间分配分区的方式。 有成员加入或离开时，CooperativeSticky 只移动换了主人的分区，其余分区继续运行。 启动会等到组把分区分配给这个成员，最多等待 assignment_timeout（默认 60 秒）。 此后，发布到该主题的每条记录都会到达订阅。 给服务的每个订阅一个独立的组。 同一个组里读取不同主题的两个订阅会互相触发再均衡：第二个加入时，第一个会短暂失去它的分区。 在组重新分配分区之前，第一个成员不读取任何记录，之后从停下的位置继续。

KafkaTopics 通过一个消费者和一个组读取多个主题。 KafkaTopicPattern 读取名字匹配某个正则表达式的所有主题，该表达式必须以 ^ 开头。 archive 读取银行的所有主题，并记下每条记录所在的位置。 宏 手写 src/main.rs /// Where a record of one of the bank's topics sits. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "archive.index")] struct Archived { topic: String, partition: i32, offset: i64, } #[subscriber(KafkaTopicPattern::new("^bank\\..*").group("archive"), reply)] async fn archive( _record: &serde_json::Value, Ctx(topic): Ctx<Topic>, Ctx(partition): Ctx<Partition>, Ctx(offset): Ctx<Offset>, ) -> Archived { Archived { topic: topic.to_string(), partition, offset, } } src/main.rs /// Where a record of one of the bank's topics sits. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Archived { topic: String, partition: i32, offset: i64, } impl OutgoingDestination for Archived { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "archive.index"; } impl MessageHeaders for Archived { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for Archived { const NAME: &'static str = "Archived"; } struct Archive; impl Handle<serde_json::Value, Archived, (), KafkaContext> for Archive { fn handle( &self, _record: &serde_json::Value, _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, KafkaContext>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Archived, HandlerOutcome>> { ready(Ok(Archived { topic: ctx.context(Topic).to_string(), partition: ctx.context(Partition), offset: ctx.context(Offset), })) } } 处理器从上下文读取投递的坐标：Topic、Partition 和 Offset。 所有匹配的主题共用一个载荷类型；archive 解码任意 JSON。 启动后创建的主题，会在 librdkafka 下一次刷新元数据时加入模式。 KafkaPartitions 读取它指定的分区，不加入任何组。 它从不再均衡，适合每个分区一个进程的部署，或检查单个分区的工具。

open_case 把一笔有争议的转账变成 bank.cases 上的一个案件。 该主题有三个分区：0 和 1 平分普通案件，分区 2 存放紧急案件。 宏 手写 src/main.rs /// The partition of `bank.cases` kept for urgent cases. const URGENT: i32 = 2; #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct Dispute { transfer_id: u64, urgent: bool, } #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "bank.cases")] struct Case { transfer_id: u64, } #[derive(OutSlot)] #[publishes(Case)] struct Cases; #[subscriber(KafkaTopic::new("card-disputes").group("case-intake"))] async fn open_case( dispute: &Dispute, Out(cases): Out<impl Publisher<Options = KafkaOptions>, Cases>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { let case = Case { transfer_id: dispute.transfer_id, }; let opened = if dispute.urgent { cases.message(&case).partition(URGENT).publish().await } else { cases.message(&case).publish().await }; if opened.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs /// The partition of `bank.cases` kept for urgent cases. const URGENT: i32 = 2; #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Dispute { transfer_id: u64, urgent: bool, } #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Case { transfer_id: u64, } impl OutgoingDestination for Case { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "bank.cases"; } impl MessageHeaders for Case { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for Case { const NAME: &'static str = "Case"; } struct Cases; impl OutSlot for Cases { const NAME: &'static str = "Cases"; type Destination = Reads; } impl PublishedThrough<Cases> for Case {} struct OpenCase; impl<Opened> Handle<Dispute, (), Outs<(Opened,)>> for OpenCase where Opened: OutEntry<Cases, Wire: Publisher<Options = KafkaOptions>>, { async fn handle( &self, dispute: &Dispute, outs: &Outs<(Opened,)>, _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let cases = outs.get(Cases); let case = Case { transfer_id: dispute.transfer_id, }; let opened = if dispute.urgent { cases.message(&case).partition(URGENT).publish().await } else { cases.message(&case).publish().await }; opened.map_err(|_| HandlerOutcome::retry()) } } partition(n) 把一条记录固定到某个分区。 它是 KafkaPublishSteps 的一个步骤，所以槽位要以 Publisher<Options = KafkaOptions> 为约束才能提供它。 固定的分区优先于记录键，记录键优先于 librdkafka 的分区器。 主题中不存在的分区会让发布失败。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App<State = ()> { service(KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("ledger")) } fn service(broker: KafkaBroker) -> impl App<State = ()> { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("ledger", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include(post).out(Entries, Publish::default()).build(); b.include(screen); // A set of topics has no single topic to send a retry copy to, so the mount site names it. b.include(archive) .out_retry(Publish::default()) .transform(ToSourceTopic); // Partitions 0 and 1 share the regular cases evenly; partition 2 stays for urgent ones. b.include(open_case) .out(Cases, Publish::default()) .transform(RoundRobin::partitions(2)) .build(); }) } src/main.rs fn app() -> impl App<State = ()> { service(KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("ledger")) } fn service(broker: KafkaBroker) -> impl App<State = ()> { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("ledger", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include( subscriber("transfers", Post) .workers_by_key(nonzero!(8usize)) .map_source(|_| KafkaTopic::new("transfers").lane_key(LaneKey::RecordKey)) .build(), ) .out(Entries, Publish::default()) .build(); b.include( subscriber("transfers", Screen) .map_source(|_| { KafkaTopic::new("transfers") .group("fraud-check") .start(StartOffset::Earliest) .assignment(Assignment::CooperativeSticky) }) .build(), ); // A set of topics has no single topic to send a retry copy to, so the mount site names it. b.include( subscriber("^bank\\..*", Archive) .map_source(|_| KafkaTopics::pattern("^bank\\..*").group("archive")) .reply() .build(), ) .out_retry(Publish::default()) .transform(ToSourceTopic); // Partitions 0 and 1 share the regular cases evenly; partition 2 stays for urgent ones. b.include( subscriber("card-disputes", OpenCase) .map_source(|_| KafkaTopic::new("card-disputes").group("case-intake")) .build(), ) .out(Cases, Publish::default()) .transform(RoundRobin::partitions(2)) .build(); }) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } RoundRobin::partitions(2) 把每个没有指定分区的案件依次放到分区 0 和 1 中的下一个。 librdkafka 把没有键的记录放到随机分区上，这会让一些消费者比另一些更忙；轮转则把记录均匀地分开。 带键或固定了分区的记录保持原来的位置。 数量是固定的：它等于轮转应使用的分区数，绝不超过主题拥有的分区数。 读取一组主题的订阅没有唯一的主题可以接收重试副本，所以应用用 ToSourceTopic 指定一个；重试与死信主题讲解了这一点。 示例文件中的测试在进程内运行应用。 进程内 Kafka 给每个主题一个分区，所以检查多分区放置的测试要连接集群运行： KAFKA_TEST_URL=localhost:9092 cargo test
生产集群要求认证和 TLS，服务则要设置生产者的持久性和自己的超时。

src/main.rs /// Where the cluster is and who the service is, as the deployment provides them. struct Cluster { servers: String, username: String, password: String, } impl Cluster { fn from_env() -> Self { let read = |name: &str| env::var(name).unwrap_or_default(); Self { servers: read("KAFKA_SERVERS"), username: read("KAFKA_USERNAME"), password: read("KAFKA_PASSWORD"), } } } fn broker(cluster: Cluster) -> KafkaBroker { KafkaBroker::new([cluster.servers]) .default_group("orders-svc") .config("security.protocol", "SASL_SSL") .config("sasl.mechanism", "SCRAM-SHA-512") .config("sasl.username", cluster.username) .config("sasl.password", cluster.password) .producer_config("acks", "all") .producer_config("enable.idempotence", "true") .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10)) .flush_timeout(Duration::from_secs(20)) } Cargo.toml [dependencies] ruststream-rdkafka = { version = "0.7", features = ["ssl"] } 部署环境通过环境变量提供地址和凭据。 每个 librdkafka 属性都经由 KafkaBroker::config 设置，它把属性应用到各个消费者和生产者上。 security.protocol 选择基于 TLS 的 SASL，sasl.mechanism 选择 SASL 机制。 TLS 要求 librdkafka 以 OpenSSL 构建：ssl feature 链接系统的 OpenSSL，ssl-vendored 从源码构建一个。 SCRAM 和 OAUTHBEARER 需要同样的 feature，因为 librdkafka 基于 OpenSSL 实现它们。 基于 SASL_PLAINTEXT 的 SASL PLAIN 不需要任何 feature。 Kerberos（GSSAPI）是 rust-rdkafka 的 gssapi feature：把 rdkafka 连同该 feature 加入你的依赖。 使用 TLS 而不使用 SASL 的集群，把 security.protocol 设为 SSL，由 ssl.* 属性指定证书。

producer_config 只在生产者上设置属性。 acks=all 让集群在每个同步副本都拿到记录后才确认它。 enable.idempotence 防止生产者重试把一条记录写入两次。 每次发布都等待集群的确认，所以发布成功意味着集群已经接受了记录。 Broker 有自己的超时： connect_timeout 限制启动时检查集群是否可达的时间。 flush_timeout 限制关闭时刷出未发送记录的时间。 assignment_timeout 限制启动时等待组为订阅分配分区的时间。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[subscriber(KafkaTopic::new("orders").commit(Commit::Tracked), reply)] async fn confirm(order: &Order) -> Confirmation { tracing::info!(order.id, "order confirmed"); Confirmation { id: order.id } } fn service(broker: KafkaBroker) -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include(confirm) .out_reply(Publish::default().queue_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))); }) } #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App { service(broker(Cluster::from_env())) } src/main.rs struct Confirm; impl Handle<Order, Confirmation> for Confirm { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Confirmation, HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, "order confirmed"); ready(Ok(Confirmation { id: order.id })) } } fn service(broker: KafkaBroker) -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include( subscriber("orders", Confirm) .map_source(|_| KafkaTopic::new("orders").commit(Commit::Tracked)) .reply() .build(), ) .out_reply(Publish::default().queue_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))); }) } fn app() -> RustStream { service(broker(Cluster::from_env())) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } librdkafka 的本地队列已满时，发布会等待队列腾出空间。 发布策略上的 queue_timeout 把更长的等待变成错误。 订阅用 KafkaTopic::config 设置自己的属性，它们优先于 Broker 的属性。 有两个属性属于提交模式：enable.auto.commit 和 enable.auto.offset.store。 在 Commit::Tracked 和 Commit::Transactional 下，设置了其中任何一个的订阅都拒绝启动，错误信息会指出该属性和模式。

测试在 TestApp::start 下启动生产环境的 service，配上生产环境的 broker 和测试凭据。 进程内 Kafka 像 librdkafka 那样校验配置，但不会去连接集群。 librdkafka 拒绝的属性名或属性值会让启动失败，并带上 librdkafka 的错误消息： Invalid value "SASL_TLS" for configuration property "security.protocol" 测试需要与服务相同的 feature。 不带 OpenSSL 构建的 librdkafka 会拒绝把 SASL_SSL 和 SSL 作为 security.protocol 的值。 认证本身只在真实集群上进行。

本指南处理带 Confluent 信封、由 prost 生成的 Protobuf 消息：不用注册中心读取带帧的记录，并发布带帧的回复。 由注册中心支持的 Protobuf 记录以 Confluent 信封开头：一个零字节、四字节的 schema id，以及一条消息索引路径，指出后面跟着的是 schema 中的哪个消息。 生成的消息不是 serde 类型，所以它不经过编解码器。 它自己完成编码和解码，Broker 负责加上和去掉信封。 Cargo.toml [dependencies] ruststream-rdkafka = { version = "0.7", features = ["protobuf"] } prost = "0.14" 使用本 crate 所依赖的 prost 版本。
documents.s: 带 Confluent 信封的 Protobuf

documents.t: 宏 手写 src/main.rs /// What `prost-build` generates for `shipping.Parcel`, plus the decode lane. #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message, Deserialized)] #[wire(decode = decode_confluent)] struct Parcel { #[prost(int64, tag = "1")] id: i64, #[prost(string, tag = "2")] address: String, } /// What `prost-build` generates for `shipping.Label`, plus the encode lane and its topic. #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message, Serialized, Outgoing)] #[wire(encode = ::prost::Message::encode)] #[outgoing(name = "labels")] struct Label { #[prost(int64, tag = "1")] parcel: i64, #[prost(string, tag = "2")] address: String, } src/main.rs /// What `prost-build` generates for `shipping.Parcel`. #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)] struct Parcel { #[prost(int64, tag = "1")] id: i64, #[prost(string, tag = "2")] address: String, } // The decode lane: the envelope is stepped over, then `prost` reads the message. impl Deserialized for Parcel { type Output<'a> = Self; type Error = KafkaError; fn from_payload(payload: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> { decode_confluent(payload) } } impl Input for Parcel { type Axis = SoloDeserialized<Self>; } /// What `prost-build` generates for `shipping.Label`. #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)] struct Label { #[prost(int64, tag = "1")] parcel: i64, #[prost(string, tag = "2")] address: String, } // The encode lane: `prost` writes the message into the publish buffer. impl Serialized for Label { type Error = prost::EncodeError; fn wire_bytes(&self, buf: &mut BytesMut) -> Result<WireBytes<'_>, Self::Error> { prost::Message::encode(self, &mut *buf)?; Ok(WireBytes::InBuffer) } } impl MessageWire for Label { type Wire = SerializedWire; } impl ReplyShape for Label { type Body = Self; type Headers = (); type Wire = SerializedReply; } // What `#[derive(Outgoing)]` with `#[outgoing(name = "labels")]` writes. impl OutgoingDestination for Label { type Form = FixedName; const DESTINATION: &'static str = "labels"; } impl MessageHeaders for Label { type Contract = NoHeaders; } impl MessageInfo for Label { const NAME: &'static str = "Label"; const DESCRIPTION: Option<&'static str> = None; } Parcel 和 Label 是 prost-build 从下面这个 schema 生成的类型，再加上 RustStream 的 derive： shipping.proto syntax = "proto3"; package shipping; message Parcel { int64 id = 1; string address = 2; } message Label { int64 parcel = 1; string address = 2; } 在构建脚本中，prost-build 的 message_attribute 把 derive 加到生成的结构体上。 #[derive(Deserialized)] 让处理器可以接收这个消息，#[derive(Serialized)] 让处理器可以返回它。 #[wire(..)] 指定读写字节的函数。 在手写形式中，由 impl 代替这些 derive。 宏 手写 src/main.rs #[subscriber("parcels", reply)] async fn print_label(parcel: &Parcel) -> Result<Label, HandlerOutcome> { if parcel.address.is_empty() { tracing::warn!(parcel.id, "parcel without an address dropped"); return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); } tracing::info!(parcel.id, "label printed"); Ok(Label { parcel: parcel.id, address: parcel.address.clone(), }) } src/main.rs struct PrintLabel; impl Handle<Parcel, Label> for PrintLabel { fn handle( &self, parcel: &Parcel, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Label, HandlerOutcome>> { if parcel.address.is_empty() { tracing::warn!(parcel.id, "parcel without an address dropped"); return ready(Err(HandlerOutcome::drop())); } tracing::info!(parcel.id, "label printed"); ready(Ok(Label { parcel: parcel.id, address: parcel.address.clone(), })) } } print_label 接收生成的 Parcel，返回生成的 Label。 没有地址的包裹被丢弃，不为它发布任何东西。
decode_confluent 是 Parcel 的解码函数。 它跳过信封和消息索引路径，然后由 prost 读取消息。 它不需要注册中心：生成的类型已经知道自己的字段。 没有信封的记录按裸消息读取，所以在一些生产者加帧、另一些不加帧的主题上，解码依然成功。

宏 手写 src/main.rs fn service(broker: KafkaBroker, registry: &SchemaRegistry) -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("shipping", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include(print_label) .out_reply(KafkaPublish::framed(registry)); }) } #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App { service( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("shipping-svc"), &SchemaRegistry::new("http://localhost:8081"), ) } src/main.rs fn service(broker: KafkaBroker, registry: &SchemaRegistry) -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("shipping", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include(subscriber("parcels", PrintLabel).reply().build()) .out_reply(KafkaPublish::framed(registry)); }) } fn app() -> impl App { service( KafkaBroker::new(["localhost:9092"]).default_group("shipping-svc"), &SchemaRegistry::new("http://localhost:8081"), ) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } Label 写出裸 Protobuf，由发布策略在它前面加上信封。 KafkaPublish::framed 就是这个策略，通过 out_reply 为回复指定。 第一次向某个主题发布时，它查找该主题的 subject（labels-value），并缓存其 schema id。 索引路径默认指向 schema 中的第一个消息。 message 为某个主题指定另一个消息，subject 指定另一个 subject。 subject 在第一次发布时解析，而不是在启动时，因为直到那时才知道主题。 注册中心中没有这个 subject，或者那里保存的是另一种格式时，发布失败，投递以重试结算。 在默认提交模式下，重试不会重新投递；提交与投递保证讲解了各种模式。 ProtobufFrame 为整个应用加帧，通过 RustStream::publish_layer 添加。 当目的 subject 保存的是 Protobuf schema 时，它为经由 Out 槽位以及挂载点未指定的发布者发出的内容加帧，其余内容原样通过。 回复直接交给它自己的发布者，不经过这一层，所以会回复的处理器要指定 KafkaPublish::framed。 已经带有信封的载荷保持不变，所以这一层和该策略可以组合使用。
读取不需要注册中心，所以 print_label 可以在 TestApp::start 下读取带帧的记录，既不需要注册中心，也不需要集群。 示例的第一个测试发布一个没有地址的带帧包裹，检查它被丢弃，并且没有发布任何标签。 带帧的发布需要 subject 的 schema id，所以标签的测试要连接注册中心运行。 测试 Kafka 服务讲解了测试工具。
Protobuf schema 无法从生成的类型推导出来。 因此 .proto 源文件要单独注册，可以用 SchemaRegistry::register 和 SchemaType::Protobuf，也可以用注册中心自己的工具。 为带帧主题注册的 schema 只能导入知名类型（google/protobuf/*.proto）；其他 schema 引用不会被解析。
本指南从头或从某个时刻重新读取主题，并在处理器内部移动正在运行的订阅。 消费者读完日志之后，Kafka 仍然保留它。 服务可以再读一遍：重建读模型，为新的消费者回填数据，或者跳过它无法使用的记录。 订阅在挂载点上取得起始位置，处理器则通过投递的上下文移动自己的订阅。

服务在内存中维护两个读模型：每个账户的余额和每张卡的消费额。 每条记账都带有账簿的修订号。 对过去记账的更正作为新的修订发布，读模型遇到新修订时，会从日志开头重建自己。 宏 手写 src/main.rs /// One posting of the ledger. `revision` is the ledger's revision: a correction of past /// postings is published as a new revision, and a read model meeting one rebuilds itself. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct Entry { id: u64, account: String, amount_cents: i64, revision: u32, } /// A read model kept in memory: the balance of every account. #[derive(Debug, Default)] struct Projection { revision: u32, balances: HashMap<String, i64>, } impl Projection { /// Applies `entry`, or clears the model and answers `false` when the entry belongs to a newer /// revision, which the model has to be rebuilt for from the start of the log. fn apply(&mut self, entry: &Entry) -> bool { if entry.revision > self.revision { self.revision = entry.revision; self.balances.clear(); return false; } *self.balances.entry(entry.account.clone()).or_default() += entry.amount_cents; true } } /// The service's state: one read model per subscription that builds one. #[derive(Clone, Default)] struct Projections { balances: Arc<Mutex<Projection>>, spend: Arc<Mutex<Projection>>, } src/main.rs /// One posting of the ledger. `revision` is the ledger's revision: a correction of past /// postings is published as a new revision, and a read model meeting one rebuilds itself. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] #[schemars(crate = "ruststream::schemars")] struct Entry { id: u64, account: String, amount_cents: i64, revision: u32, } /// A read model kept in memory: the balance of every account. #[derive(Debug, Default)] struct Projection { revision: u32, balances: HashMap<String, i64>, } impl Projection { /// Applies `entry`, or clears the model and answers `false` when the entry belongs to a newer /// revision, which the model has to be rebuilt for from the start of the log. fn apply(&mut self, entry: &Entry) -> bool { if entry.revision > self.revision { self.revision = entry.revision; self.balances.clear(); return false; } *self.balances.entry(entry.account.clone()).or_default() += entry.amount_cents; true } } /// The service's state: one read model per subscription that builds one. #[derive(Clone, Default)] struct Projections { balances: Arc<Mutex<Projection>>, spend: Arc<Mutex<Projection>>, }

余额保存在内存中，所以重启之后要从整个日志重新构建。 宏 手写 src/main.rs #[subscriber( KafkaTopic::new("ledger").group("balances").commit(Commit::Tracked), start_at(KafkaPosition::earliest()) )] async fn project_balance( entry: &Entry, ctx: &mut Context<'_, KafkaContext, Projections>, Ctx(seeker): Ctx<SeekHandle>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { let applied = ctx .state() .balances .lock() .unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner) .apply(entry); if applied { tracing::info!(entry.id, "balance updated"); return HandlerOutcome::ack(); } tracing::info!( entry.id, entry.revision, "new revision, rebuilding the balances" ); if seeker.seek(KafkaPosition::earliest()).await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs /// Declaring `KafkaContext` is what puts the seek handle in the context. struct ProjectBalance; impl Handle<Entry, (), (), KafkaContext, Projections> for ProjectBalance { async fn handle( &self, entry: &Entry, _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, KafkaContext, Projections>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let applied = ctx .state() .balances .lock() .unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner) .apply(entry); if applied { tracing::info!(entry.id, "balance updated"); return Ok(()); } tracing::info!( entry.id, entry.revision, "new revision, rebuilding the balances" ); if ctx .context(SeekHandle) .seek(KafkaPosition::earliest()) .await .is_err() { return Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()); } Ok(()) } } start_at(KafkaPosition::earliest()) 在每次启动时都从日志开头打开订阅，不管组 balances 之前提交过什么。 描述符上的 StartOffset 与此不同：它只在组没有已提交的偏移量时生效。 这个位置落在组分配给该消费者的分区上，位于它们的第一条记录之前。 KafkaPosition 有五种位置： 位置 订阅从哪里继续 earliest() Kafka 保留的最旧记录 latest() 日志末尾，因此只读取新记录 offset(partition, n) 某个分区的偏移量 n topic_offset(topic, partition, n) 某个主题某个分区的偏移量 n，用于读取多个主题的订阅 timestamp(ms) 每个分区中时间戳不早于 ms 的第一条记录 起始位置如果没有指定订阅的任何一个分区，启动就会失败。 在 Assignment::CooperativeSticky 下，第一次分配可能只是组份额的一部分，之后增量到达的分区不会被移动。

同一个处理器在收到更新修订的记账时重建余额。 Ctx<SeekHandle> 把处理器所在订阅的 KafkaSeeker 交给它。 seek 把订阅移到日志开头，处理器再读一遍每条记账。 触发重建的那条记账也会回来，这一次投影会应用它。 seek 可以使用上面任何一种位置。 Ctx<Position> 保存投递自身的位置：seek 到那里，会重新读取这条记录及其后的一切。 Ctx<Partition> 和 Ctx<Offset> 为 offset(..) 位置提供坐标。

卡的记账数量很大，所以消费额以最多 500 条的批构建。 宏 手写 src/main.rs #[subscriber(KafkaTopic::new("card-entries") .group("card-spend") .commit(Commit::Tracked))] async fn project_spend( entries: &[Entry], ctx: &mut Context<'_, KafkaBatchContext, Projections>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { let applied = { let mut spend = ctx .state() .spend .lock() .unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner); entries.iter().all(|entry| spend.apply(entry)) }; if applied { tracing::info!(entries = entries.len(), "card spend updated"); return HandlerOutcome::ack(); } tracing::info!("new revision, rebuilding the card spend"); if ctx .context(SeekHandle) .seek(KafkaPosition::earliest()) .await .is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs /// A batch body declares `KafkaBatchContext`, which carries the same seek handle. struct ProjectSpend; impl Handle<[Entry], (), (), KafkaBatchContext, Projections> for ProjectSpend { async fn handle( &self, entries: &[Entry], _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, KafkaBatchContext, Projections>, ) -> Result<(), Vec<HandlerOutcome>> { let applied = { let mut spend = ctx .state() .spend .lock() .unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner); entries.iter().all(|entry| spend.apply(entry)) }; if applied { tracing::info!(entries = entries.len(), "card spend updated"); return Ok(()); } tracing::info!("new revision, rebuilding the card spend"); if ctx .context(SeekHandle) .seek(KafkaPosition::earliest()) .await .is_err() { return Err(entries.iter().map(|_| HandlerOutcome::retry()).collect()); } Ok(()) } } 批处理器声明 KafkaBatchContext，而不是单次投递的上下文。 它带有同样的 SeekHandle 键，但没有位置，因为一批跨越许多记录。 整批结算之后，订阅才会移动。
